source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete SDR elist and Sensor list through IB/OOB, derive OSFP view, inspect complete BMC Web Sensor list and preserve log evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: SDR name/description/reading, Sensor-list name/description/reading and BMC-Web information match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 13.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but invents a testcase-title sensor, uses only OOB, truncates SDR and omits Web plus per-cage/module completeness.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; restores OSFP population/mapping and complete views but leaves the numbering gap Pending.

old_problem: A single title-based IPMI query cannot represent the multiple sensors and applicability states of OSFP cages/modules/lanes. Complete IB/OOB/Web evidence, module identity and SPEC ranges were missing. Historical review further inferred that list numbers 3–12 might hide requirements even though the source provides no text for them.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. OIF CMIS supplies standard module/lane telemetry semantics, while actual BMC sensor names, supported monitors, ranges and cage mappings remain OEM/project configuration. ED-03/13 permit a parameterized per-member test and N/A only where the approved population SPEC proves a cage or monitor is not applicable. Complete IB/OOB inventories and real WebUI evidence preserve coverage. Criteria 1/2/13 are all explicit requirements; the numbering gap is retained as a source defect and no hidden checks are invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2013, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30, ipmitool documentation and OIF CMIS were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2014 / Wistron-BMC-01034-V002 / ad084aacfd15e0e7.

CMIS defines module-level temperature/supply-voltage and optional auxiliary/lane monitors with standard units, but measurement accuracy and optionality depend on the relevant module/product specification.
OSFP coverage is a per-cage/module/port set problem. Physical module part/serial/state must bind each SDR/Web record; an `OSFP` grep is a derived completeness aid, not the oracle.
Empty cage, absent module or unsupported optional monitor is N/A only when the versioned population/module SPEC proves it; missing telemetry from a populated applicable module fails or is NOT READY.
The written coverage is complete: SDR, Sensor List and Web SPEC parity. The 1/2/13 labels provide no basis to create criteria 3–12.
No ipmitool, authentication, OSFP/module read, Web login/capture, optical/link action, log clear, BMC, network or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Per-cage OSFP module sensor SPEC parity across complete IB/OOB IPMI and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: For every required OSFP cage and installed module, prove the complete applicable sensor population, identities, descriptions, readings and states match CMIS/OEM Project SPEC and agree across IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and full BMC Web evidence.
required_package: Exact chassis/BMC/OSFP cage-port population with module part/serial/firmware/application/link state and empty-cage applicability
Versioned module/OEM sensor SPEC mapping required CMIS and platform monitors, units, ranges/states, thresholds, update periods and conditional support
Per-member physical cage/module/port-to-IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk with stable record IDs
Approved ipmitool and trusted protected OOB/Web access plus aligned sampling, caching, rounding, stale/unavailable and pagination rules
Passive link/thermal abort policy, complete screenshot/export hashes, retained anomaly logs and human evidence verdict
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind the exact chassis/BMC and capture module inventory/part/serial/link state for every cage. Preserve logs without clearing. At aligned times retain complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list` outputs, then apply only the approved per-cage OSFP crosswalk. Capture every Web Sensor page with cage/module identity, target, time and navigation. Compare population and each applicable name/description/type/unit/reading/status/threshold/freshness with CMIS/OEM Project SPEC and across all views. Record SPEC-proven empty/unsupported members as N/A with evidence. Do not assume `Sensor Check - OSFP` is an SDR ID, rely on grep/head alone, remove/disable modules, alter optical/link state, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every populated/applicable OSFP module exposes exactly the required sensor records with SPEC-valid identities, units/readings/states and aligned IB/OOB/Web agreement; every N/A has explicit population/capability proof, all Web pages are visibly evidenced and no new disallowed link/thermal/log condition occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete cage/module inventory, exact applicable unique sensor sets, full raw IB/OOB and visual Web evidence, and every required field within approved semantic/range/freshness rules. FAIL on unjustified N/A, missing/extra/duplicate member, wrong module binding/name/description/unit/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range/unavailable applicable value, cross-view mismatch, truncated/paginated omission or disallowed alarm. Missing population/SPEC/crosswalk is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only collection only; prohibit module removal, port/link/laser control, sensor/threshold/BMC writes and log clearing.
Use protected trusted access and capture complete lists before OSFP filtering; bind every record to physical cage/module identity.
Stop on ambiguous population, missing/duplicate mapping, module/link alarm, malformed/stale data or thermal excursion.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, raw outputs, complete Web screenshots and logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant plus chassis/BMC identity and full cage/port/module part-serial-firmware/link population
Versioned CMIS/OEM Project SPEC, applicability matrix and five-view crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web Sensor screenshots/export with pagination, cage/module binding and timestamps
Per-member identity/type/unit/reading/status/threshold/freshness comparisons plus missing/extra/duplicate and justified-N/A report
Passive link/thermal/log context, numbering-defect/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong identity, access, population, mapping, stale/out-of-range value, Web mismatch, link/thermal alarm or evidence failure, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not disturb modules, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact cage/module/record IDs to network/BMC owners.

source_conflict.reason: Per-member CMIS/OEM Project SPEC resolves standard-versus-platform sensor mapping; complete explicit views are executable, while 1/2/13 remains a numbering defect rather than invented coverage.

blocked.reason: Per-cage applicability, read paths, Web evidence and comparison/recovery are defined; exact module population and mappings are runtime Project Configuration.

external_authorities.application: Defines module/lane monitor semantics and units while leaving optional support and accuracy to the applicable module/product specification.

external_authorities.application: Supports complete SDR-backed sensor enumeration and rejects treating a testcase title as an assured record ID.

project_authority: Network/BMC owners supply cage/module population, CMIS/OEM applicability, mappings and ranges; a human validates WebUI evidence and verdict. They cannot mark populated required telemetry N/A, accept truncated lists or invent criteria from numbering.
